recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. The current core source satisfies FHIR-23921 when successor resource names and later published refinements are considered; future work should not duplicate the existing FHIR-31528, FHIR-39043, FHIR-26673, or FHIR-26460 audits.
issue_request: FHIR-23921 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and asked that product OtherCharacteristics no longer be a lone CodeableConcept; the accepted resolution broadened this to replacing physical and other characteristics with a repeating code plus value[x] pair for manufactured items and packaged products.
initial_application: No FHIR-23921-keyed implementation commit was found. Historical medication-definition rework shortly after the issue was raised, especially commits 7512379e821e and 1514f5f443a3, moved packaged/manufactured product characteristics toward repeated code/value structures, with later R5 refactors carrying the model into current StructureDefinition XML.
additional_context: The seed's old MedicinalProduct* artifact names now map to current successor resources in fhir.ini. Later Published related issues refined the same family: FHIR-26673 renamed nested characteristics to property/type naming, FHIR-31528 remodelled MedicinalProductDefinition.characteristic as a type/value backbone, FHIR-39043 connected PackagedProductDefinition.characteristic to the packaging property backbone, and FHIR-26460 handled CodeableConcept value typing. Those related decisions already have combined-branch audit commits.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The active current StructureDefinitions already have type/value modelling for MedicinalProductDefinition.characteristic, PackagedProductDefinition.packaging.property and top-level characteristic, ManufacturedItemDefinition.property, and AdministrableProductDefinition.property; focused searches found no remaining OtherCharacteristics or physicalCharacteristics element in the active product-definition source folders requiring a FHIR-23921 fix.
